line: Leaves me alone with his wife I wish he didn’t—
vault_lines: Leaves me alone with his wife
meaning:
Sample of Bobby Womack’s ‘I Wish He Didn’t Trust Me So Much’ touching on shared guilt and internal conflict of having an affair with his best friend’s wife.

Within the context of this song, Summer transforms this into an empowering feminine perspective where one should not settle for less when someone could be in her words, “doin' me better”, this means choosing herself over a one-sided relationship.
